companyFieldUpdates.subsector: Renewable power and green-fuels development (scope under review)
companyFieldUpdates.description: Helax Istmo is a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners-owned development company for a large renewable-energy and industrial project in Oaxaca, Mexico. CIP's December 2023 disclosure identifies Helax as wholly owned collectively by CI Growth Markets Fund II and Copenhagen Infrastructure Energy Transition Fund I and describes a memorandum of understanding with Mexican authorities for an originally proposed renewable-power, green-hydrogen and green-maritime-fuels development. The individual fund split, entry date and committed project equity were not disclosed. CIP later said the project structure and scope remained under review, while public reporting indicated a possible redesign toward electricity generation. No current concession, final permit, offtake agreement, final investment decision, financing close, construction start or operating asset was verified. Helax remains one pre-development PortCo; CIIT, SEMAR, the Ciudad Ixtepec industrial site and any project facilities are counterparties or assets rather than separate owners. No sale, partner entry, exit or signed pending ownership transaction was found through August 19, 2026.

set.event: CIP disclosed that Helax was wholly owned collectively by CI Growth Markets Fund II and Copenhagen Infrastructure Energy Transition Fund I and announced a development-stage MoU with Mexican authorities.

CIP said Helax's structure and scope remained under review and that advancement was conditional; no FID, financing close, construction or operation was verified.
